function: Bundled experimental REFLEX reference compiler, prepared evaluator, data-only transport and evaluation inspector.
capabilities: Report NORMAL, ANOMALY, UNKNOWN or REQUEST_REVIEW without external effects
adaptation: Use python -m mantleos reflex-book. KPP Reflex source staging is separate. No production executable profile is registered.
verified_with: Reproduce current tests and release evidence; tests and matching hashes do not grant Baker acceptance.
provenance: REFLEX 0.1 owner-supplied handoff, native attachment continuation and prepared-program hardening candidate, 25 October 2026.

usage.use_when: A fixed, typed, reviewable rule should produce repeated deterministic reports without further model calls.
inputs: Canonical REFLEX IR or framed executable
Immutable typed input snapshot and injected UTC clock
Independent host expectations and approval policy
usage.limits: Bundled experimental module: synthetic geography, no external effects, no production approval, no native execution profile. Admission remains an isolated simulation.
